name: taobao-mnn/MNN-Pocket-0.3B model card
notes: Fetched 2026-11-10 via the HF raw README endpoint (9,543 bytes). Repo created 2026-09-23T09:54:34Z per the API; 1,133 downloads and 90 likes at crawl. Card is the base for the family: MNN-Pocket-0.3B (SFT instruction-tuned), -Base (pretrain), -SFT, -INT4 (W4A16 QAT MNN build, 173 MB), -GGUF (F16/Q8_0 from BF16, Q4_1 from QAT), -MNN, -DFlash2 (draft), and -Dec (a separate non-autoregressive decision model, which is a different record class). Section 'Performance' prints one markdown table: 11 rows (Average, C-Eval, CMMLU, MMLU-Redux, BBH, IFEval, IFEval-zh, GSM8K, MGSM-zh, MATH500, HumanEval, MBPP) against 8 baseline columns (its own -INT4, Gemma-3-270M, ERNIE-4.5-0.3B, LFM2.5-350M, SmolLM2-360M, Hunyuan-0.5B, MiniCPM4-0.5B, Qwen3-0.6B). All 8 baselines are same-size or near-same-size, which is what makes the table useful. The card attributes protocol to 'Full protocol in the tech report' (arXiv 2611.12311) and prints none of it inline - no shot counts, no prompt format, no harness. That limitation is carried into the model record. Quant claim, printed by the card and verified as arithmetic: INT4 average 49.59 vs BF16 50.00, a 0.41pp loss. On-device throughput table (INT4, 512-token context): iPad Pro M5 Metal 8,721 prefill / 466 decode tok/s; iPad Pro M5 CPU 2,228 / 231; Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 OpenCL 3,403 / 138; Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 CPU 930 / 251. Vendor claim, no methodology printed.
